v2-1.0.0.description: Same criteria; common frame, evidence tagged by source, verifiable quote, no reported value.

impact_area_gender.label: Gender equality, youth and social inclusion (Impact Area tag)
impact_area_gender.component: only when the value is 2, the component(s) the result primarily addresses, from: Gender Equality; Youth; Social Inclusion (separate several with "; "). Otherwise null.
impact_area_gender.explanation: Reference specific aspects of the result, say why the value fits and briefly why the other two values do not.

innovation_readiness_level.label: Innovation Readiness Level
innovation_readiness_level.component: a one-line description of the prime innovation assessed.
innovation_readiness_level.explanation: Reference the concrete evidence (document title and page or section when available), say why the level fits and what critical evidence is missing for a higher level.
